Committed the single source-store path (588513d8e), redeployed, confirmed the deployed copy byte-identical, and re-ran the invariants script: C5 PASS, ALL CHECKS PASSED.

memory_candidates.content: check-module-invariants.sh C5 matches every dotted chain `FormalSystem(.[A-Z]\w*)+` in non-specs markdown and requires it to resolve to a .lean file or directory. Because the match is greedy over CAPITALIZED segments only, a fully-qualified citation whose final segment is a lowercase declaration (`FormalSystem.Semantics.FrameOver.ofStep`) truncates to a real module and passes, but a fully-qualified citation of a Capitalized declaration (`FormalSystem.PlusLanguage.PlusValidZTime`, a `def` in PlusValidity.lean) is read whole as a module path and fails. In context notes, cite Capitalized declarations by bare name (or allowlist in scripts/module-invariants-allowlist.txt after verifying it is a live declaration), never by dotted fully-qualified path.
